subject: Invitation to our Summer Networking Event
body: Dear valued attendees, We are excited to invite you to our annual Summer Networking Event on July 15th at the Grand Hotel. Join us for an evening of networking opportunities, delicious food, and exciting entertainment. This event is a great chance to connect with industry professionals and expand your business network. RSVP by July 5th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, The Event Planning Team
